scope: Evidence for the speed-limited corridor carry checkpoint (20261101T024024, iteration 299; walking above 0.3 m/s penalized): the same 256 held-out corridors and masses (seeds 201/202) and the same four showcase corridors (seed 203) and camera as the unlimited checkpoint's evaluation (20261101T022430), so the two policies compare directly.
